text: dsh-nx 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Siemens NX MCP 集成，通过 stdio 注册建模与检查工具，包括创建零件、草图、拉伸和孔，查询特征与测量实体。接口也提供预检、结果核验和工作区路径限制。当前随附的 NXOpen bridge 只实现健康与能力查询，其他操作仍关闭；mock 仅模拟结果。配置 bridge 需本机回环地址和 bearer token。

dsh-nx connects DeepSeek Harness to Siemens NX through stdio MCP tools for parts, sketches, holes, and inspection. The bundled NXOpen bridge supports diagnostics only; other operations are disabled. Mock mode simulates results. A configured bridge uses a loopback URL and bearer token.
想让 agent 用结构化工具创建 Siemens NX 零件和草图。
有没有办法通过 MCP 查询当前 CAD 模型的特征和实体测量信息？
希望把建模步骤封装成可以预检、执行后再核验的工具调用。
我需要从草图拉伸实体，并添加孔或矩形阵列。
I want an MCP interface for inspecting a Siemens NX session and its model features.
Let an agent create CAD sketches, extrusions, holes, and patterns with typed tool inputs.
dsh-nx 的功能「NX 建模工具」：类型化 MCP 接口涵盖零件、表达式、草图、拉伸和孔等操作。通过 stdio 工具调用；随附 NXOpen bridge 尚未启用这些处理器，mock 只模拟结果。
dsh-nx 的功能「模型状态检查」：可通过工具查询健康状态、支持能力、当前会话、特征列表和实体测量，并提供操作前预检及变更后核验接口。调用对应 MCP 工具；NXOpen bridge 当前只响应健康和能力查询，其余处理器未验证而关闭。
dsh-nx 的功能「工作区路径限制」：零件和导出路径解析到配置的 CAD 工作区内，零件路径还必须以 .prt 结尾。由保存或导出工具传入相对路径时触发校验，越出工作区或扩展名不符会报错。
dsh-nx 通过配置的 bearer token 调用仅限回环地址的 bridge；随附 NXOpen bridge 暂未启用建模处理器。

dsh-nx README · dsh-nx：English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

`dsh-nx` is an experimental DeepSeek Harness bundle for safe, local Siemens NX automation through MCP. Version `0.1.0` ships the current DSH bundle manifest, a typed MCP server, a Chinese/English-compatible modeling skill, workspace policy, mock bridge, doctor command, and an explicit protocol boundary for a future validated NX 2512 bridge.

> This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Siemens or DeepSeek.

dsh-nx README · Current status：- The MCP server, schemas, workspace confinement, mock bridge and stdio end-to-end tests run on Linux and Windows.
- The repository does **not yet contain a real-NX-accepted NX 2512 bridge**.
- Mock results always contain `mock: true` and never write `.prt` or STEP files.
- Do not use this release on production parts.

dsh-nx README · Install in DeepSeek Harness：DeepSeek Harness removed the old `.dsh-plugin` repository format. This project uses the current npm bundle form (`package.json.dsh.bundle` + `cordis.patch.yml`). From the profile where you want NX tools:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ethanrise/dsh-nx
```

Tagged releases also publish a prebuilt, version-independent asset named
`dsh-nx.tgz`. It avoids building TypeScript on the target machine:

dsh-nx README · Install in DeepSeek Harness：```text
https://github.com/ethanrise/dsh-nx/releases/latest/download/dsh-nx.tgz
```

Install the included skill for project-scoped discovery:

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .dsh\skills\nx-modeling | Out-Null
Copy-Item node_modules\dsh-nx\skills\nx-modeling\SKILL.md .dsh\skills\nx-modeling\SKILL.md
```

During repository development:

```sh
npm install
npm run check
DSH_NX_MODE=mock npm run dev
```

dsh-nx README · Configuration：| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `DSH_NX_WORKSPACE` | Only directory the server may use for CAD files |
| `DSH_NX_BRIDGE_URL` | Loopback-only bridge URL, for example `http://127.0.0.1:48161/rpc` |
| `DSH_NX_BRIDGE_TOKEN` | Random bearer token shared with the local bridge |
| `DSH_NX_TIMEOUT_MS` | Tool timeout; default 30000 |
| `DSH_NX_MODE=mock` | Test-only stateful mock; never creates CAD files |
| `DSH_NX_ROOT` | NX installation root used by `dsh-nx-doctor` |
dsh-nx README · Configuration：No arbitrary journal, Python, C#, or shell execution tool is exposed.

dsh-nx README · Tool surface：Health/capabilities, new part, named expression, rectangle/circle sketch, extrusion, simple hole, rectangular pattern, bounded fillet/chamfer, feature listing, body measurement, safe save-as, STEP AP242 export, and undo.

The workflow also exposes session-state, preflight and post-mutation verification tools. See [`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md), the sample [`four-hole-plate.json`](examples/four-hole-plate.json), and the Windows scripts under [`scripts/`](scripts/).

dsh-nx README · NX 2512 validation gate：A real adapter is supported only after all checks pass on native Windows + licensed NX 2512: create a parameterized four-hole plate, inspect native feature history, change an expression and rebuild, verify body count/bounding box/volume, save-close-reopen, export STEP, and undo. Until evidence is recorded under `docs/nx2512-validation.md`, the default bridge fails closed.

dsh-nx README · Marketplace：DSH Desktop obtains community listings through `dsh-market` and the
`awesome-dsh-plugin` catalog. See [`docs/marketplace.md`](docs/marketplace.md)
for the release checklist and conservative submission entry. This repository
must not be advertised as real NX automation until the validation gate passes.
dsh-nx README · License：MIT applies to this repository's code. Siemens NX, NXOpen libraries, documentation, licenses, and user part files are not distributed.

dsh-nx README · dsh-nx：[English](README.md) | 简体中文

`dsh-nx`是一个面向DeepSeek Harness的实验性Siemens NX本地自动化Bundle，通过MCP暴露类型明确、受策略限制的建模工具。

> 本项目与Siemens、DeepSeek均无隶属或官方背书关系。

dsh-nx README · 当前状态：`0.1.0`已包含：当前DSH Bundle格式、MCP服务、NX建模Skill、工作区安全策略、Mock Bridge、doctor、stdio端到端测试、Windows安装/构建脚本和NX 2512验收清单。

**目前尚未在真实Windows + NX 2512环境完成Bridge验收。**默认状态下所有写操作都会关闭失败；`DSH_NX_MODE=mock`只用于协议和Agent流程测试，返回结果始终带`mock: true`，不会生成`.prt`。

dsh-nx README · 安装：最新版DeepSeek Harness已经移除旧`.dsh-plugin`仓库格式，本项目使用`package.json.dsh.bundle`和`cordis.patch.yml`：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ethanrise/dsh-nx
```

每个正式Tag还会自动发布固定文件名的预编译包，目标电脑无需编译TypeScript：

```text
https://github.com/ethanrise/dsh-nx/releases/latest/download/dsh-nx.tgz
```

将Skill复制到当前项目可发现目录：

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .dsh\skills\nx-modeling | Out-Null
Copy-Item node_modules\dsh-nx\skills\nx-modeling\SKILL.md .dsh\skills\nx-modeling\SKILL.md
```

dsh-nx README · 安装：开发和Mock测试：

```sh
npm install
npm run check
DSH_NX_MODE=mock npm run dev
```

dsh-nx README · 安全边界：- 仅允许访问`DSH_NX_WORKSPACE`；
- Bridge仅允许本机回环地址并要求随机令牌；
- 默认不覆盖、不删除文件；
- 不提供任意Journal、Python、C#或Shell执行；
- Mock结果绝不能作为真实NX执行证据；
- 超时写操作不得自动重试，必须先检查NX状态。

dsh-nx README · 第一版工具：环境检查、能力查询、会话状态、操作预检、结果验证、新建零件、Expression、矩形/圆草图、拉伸、简单孔、矩形阵列、受限圆角/倒角、特征树查询、实体测量、安全另存、STEP AP242导出和Undo。

装配、钣金、工程图、PMI、CAM、CAE、Teamcenter、复杂曲面、NX 1946及远程工作站不属于`0.1.0`。
dsh-nx README · Ubuntu说明：Ubuntu可以开发和测试MCP、Skill、Mock Bridge与安全策略，但不能验证NXOpen或原生`.prt`。真实支持声明必须在原生Windows + 合法NX 2512许可证环境完成验收。
dsh-nx README · 插件市场：DSH Desktop通过`dsh-market`和`awesome-dsh-plugin`目录获得社区插件列表。发布检查、市场条目模板和提交步骤见[`docs/marketplace.md`](docs/marketplace.md)。真实NX验收通过前，市场描述必须明确本项目仍为实验性实现。
